summary: 22-year-old Colorado Springs hiker stranded after dark on Quandary Peak when his headlamp failed; he had left his pack at ~13,000 ft and continued to the summit without it. Friends called 911; Summit County Rescue Group paged 9:38 p.m.; 15 rescuers located him ~11:30 p.m. and walked him out by ~12:45 a.m. Nov 7.
notes: Metro to Mountain journal entry dated Nov 9, 2010 ('Over the weekend, a 22 year old climber called for help...'), citing the Denver Post as its source; Nov 6, 2010 was a Saturday (Saturday-verified); rescue spanned midnight into Nov 7. Times (9:38 p.m. page, 11:30 p.m. located, 12:45 a.m. out) and the hiker's hometown per the Denver Post account as quoted in a forum post - Denver Post URL not directly verifiable (domain blocked for fetch), so only the journal URL is cited. Run 1020 chunk A; first 2010 Quandary row.
